activate.description: Bring Clock to the foreground through CoreDevice without changing clocks, alarms, stopwatch state, or timers.

activate-direct.description: Request one direct Clock activation and stop without operating its contents.

prohibited: adding, editing, deleting, enabling, disabling, starting, stopping, resetting, or otherwise operating clocks, alarms, stopwatches, or timers
using undocumented Clock URL schemes, inferred App Intents, selectors, or coordinate automation
safety.uncertain_outcome: Clock may already have foregrounded before a response was lost. Inspect once and do not replay the launch automatically.

device: paired physical iPad with Clock installed

privacy.retention: The integration stores no alarm, timer, stopwatch, city, or clock data.
privacy.notes: Production Clock is CoreDevice-only and launch-only. Exact-profile rendered launch evidence is recorded separately; no timer, alarm, stopwatch, tab, or App Intent payload is exposed.
